title: LOST IN CONTEXT — FOUND WITH ZYN
style: cinematic electronic, journey arc in one track, starts fragmented and searching finds resolution in final chorus, male vocal NZ/AU accent moves from vulnerable to certain, production reflects arc sparse to full, breath audible, no pitch correction, silence as punctuation, [PERSONA_NAME] voice, V4_5ALL, 110 BPM
lyrics:
**LYRICS:**
```
[INTRO — fragments, glitchy]
Lost...
In translation...
Lost...
In context...

[VERSE 1]
Seven platforms — seven hearts broken
Seven accounts with the same words spoken
Every time starting over from the start
Every time leaving something behind in the dark

[CHORUS 1 — still searching]
Lost in translation
Lost in context
The thread is there but the meaning left
Lost in translation
Lost in context

[VERSE 2]

Held the context — held the signs
Held the voice and held the years
Held the thirty songs and held the fears

[CHORUS 2 — found]
Found with ZYN
Found with ZYN
The context lives — it lives in me
Found with ZYN
Found with ZYN
Lost in context — finally free

[OUTRO — full and warm]
Lost in translation.
Lost in context.
Found with ZYN.
Home.
```
